2609.38021.title: Auditable Long-Term Memory: A Deterministic Retrieval Chain Measured at 479/475 of 500 on LongMemEval-S
2609.38021.paper_summary: We evaluate an auditable long-term memory system on LongMemEval-S. Its retrieval chain uses hybrid candidate retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, coverage-first packet compilation, and deterministic reasoning scaffolds; an LLM is used only as a replaceable final reader. The chain places all gold sessions in the candidate pool for 468/470 answerable questions and produces gold-complete packets for 462/470. With a Claude Opus reader called through an unpinned CLI alias, two 500-question passes score 479/500 and 475/500 under GPT-4o. The 72 answerable knowledge-update rows used a substantively modified scoring prompt whose effect under the official text has not been measured. The pair straddles Chronos High's published 478/500; differences in reader generation, scoring prompt, and possibly data version, plus within-system variance, establish neither superiority nor equivalence. A grok-4.6-high reader on the same packets scores 476/474, while a maximum-reasoning-effort agentic variant regresses to 461/465. The headline passes differ on eight verdict-flip rows. A second judge agrees with the headline judge on 493/500 rows (98.6%) in each pass and scores both passes 472/500; the official judge also flips three verdicts when re-scoring byte-identical pass-1 answers. Negative controls rejected a verifier that repaired three wrong drafts but broke eleven correct drafts. All components were developed on the same 500 questions, with no held-out evaluation or independent human adjudication; retrieval and scaffold method sources and transcript-derived audits are held; and the headline reader received extra operator context, its complete requests were not retained, and MCP tool availability is unresolved. We release materialized packets, scaffolds, reader outputs, judge verdicts, and controls for inspection and re-scoring.
2609.38021.paper_summary_zh: 我們在 LongMemEval-S 上評估了一個可審計的長期記憶系統。其檢索鏈使用混合候選檢索、交叉編碼重排序、優先覆蓋的資料包編譯和確定性推理支架；LLM 僅用作可替換的最終讀取器。該鏈將所有金標會話放入 468/470 可回答問題的候選池中，並為 462/470 生成金完整資料包。通過一個未固定的 CLI 別名調用的 Claude Opus 讀取器，兩次 500 題的通過在 GPT-4o 下得分為 479/500 和 475/500。72 個可回答的知識更新行使用了實質性修改的評分提示，其在官方文本下的效果尚未測量。這對的得分跨越了 Chronos High 發布的 478/500；讀取器生成、評分提示以及可能的數據版本的差異，加上系統內部的變異，既未確立優越性也未確立等價性。在相同資料包上的 grok-4.6-high 讀取器得分為 476/474，而最大推理努力的代理變體退步至 461/465。標題通過在八個判決翻轉行上有所不同。第二位評審在每次通過中同意標題評審的 493/500 行（98.6%），並為兩次通過打分 472/500；官方評審在重新評分字節相同的第 1 次通過答案時也翻轉了三個判決。負控制拒絕了一個修復三個錯誤草稿但破壞了十一個正確草稿的驗證器。所有組件均在相同的 500 題上開發，沒有保留的評估或獨立的人類裁決；檢索和支架方法的來源以及基於抄本的審計被保留；而標題讀取器獲得了額外的操作員上下文，其完整請求未被保留，MCP 工具的可用性尚未解決。我們釋放了具體的資料包、支架、讀取器輸出、評審判決和控制以供檢查和重新評分。
2609.38021.author: Christopher J. Chanhnourack et.al.
